testcase.name: empty or whitespace-only search returns the selected category in API order
search matches name, category and SKU independently without case or accent sensitivity
search normalizes decomposed accents and repeated whitespace
every query term must match, allowing terms across different searchable fields
category selection and search combine with AND instead of expanding results
user punctuation is literal and never interpreted as a regular expression
filtering never alters API rows, preserves references and returns a separate array
empty data and unmatched queries produce empty results without fabricated products
the all-category key only affects selection and is not a magic search query
configuration permits LAN HTTP only in a development build/environment
the actual health contract is validated at runtime
GET health uses the root route, no credentials, and validates the response
HTTP errors retain status, do not reflect server secrets, and do not retry
unexpected body types, malformed JSON and invalid shape are rejected
network errors are sanitized
timeout aborts a request and also bounds a stalled JSON body
external cancellation is distinct and pre-cancelled requests never fetch
catalog contract validates remote data and nullable photos
catalog gets products and categories from HTTP; never substitutes local demo items
catalog follows server cursors and avoids duplicate page fetches
catalog does not confuse API failures with an empty catalog
demo preview from Neon is explicitly non-purchasable and has no brand field
demo preview rejects server errors instead of using the ten static fixtures
demo detail validates identity and reads only the requested item from the API
commercial detail validates description but does not mark merchandise as demo
missing demo details return 404 and invalid remote contracts do not produce fake products
all storefront screens exclude provisional-price and photo-review labels
internal demo protections and real product lookup stay in place
product cards navigate to actual details without purchase actions
